read.thesis: Q4 2024 sales fell 5% to $16.2B with dealer machine destock of $1.6B, but E&T backlog rose to $30B and large recip engine capacity is being expanded 125% over 2023; 2025 guided to slightly lower sales, margins top half of range.

capex.quote: we expect growth in reciprocating engines for power generation in 2025

triggers.label: Large recip engine capacity +125% over 2023
triggers.quote: we are expanding capacity by about 125% over 2023 - that will happen over the next several years

triggers.label: 2025 price realization about -1% of sales
triggers.quote: price realization should account for about a 1% decrease in sales for the full year

triggers.label: Machine dealer inventory down $1.6B in Q4
triggers.quote: For machines, dealer inventory decreased by $1.6 billion.

triggers.label: Backlog up $1.3B to $30B
triggers.quote: Since last quarter end, our backlog increased by $1.3 billion to $30 billion.

guidance.quote: we currently anticipate 2025 sales and revenues to be slightly lower compared to 2024
Full year adjusted operating profit margin is expected to be lower than 2024, but it is anticipated to be in the top half of the target range
we expect ME&T free cash flow to be in the top half of our target range of $5 billion to $10 billion
We anticipate CapEx of about $2.5 billion in 2025

red_flags.label: Price realization negative ~1% of sales in 2025
red_flags.quote: price realization should account for about a 1% decrease in sales for the full year

red_flags.label: Q1 2025 margin seasonality not expected
red_flags.quote: we do not expect this seasonal trend to occur in 2025

evasions.quote: as we always do, a year from now we'll reassess and let you know what we think for 2026
